title: Pre-K Tuition Agreement Terms: Payments, Withdrawal Notice and Refunds
content:
These terms of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions govern payments, withdrawal notice and refunds on a Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) enrollment.

**1. Payment methods and application (no longer in force).** The former term that tuition is paid by the methods the type accepts and is applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first, and that a payment never moves to a sibling's enrollment, is no longer in force as written; it has been superseded by the current payment basis.

**2. Written notice of withdrawal.** When the family gives written notice of withdrawal from tuition-based Pre-K, tuition stops after the type's withdrawal notice period. The notice is a withdrawal notice document logged on the enrollment, and its received date is the notice date (day 0); the period is counted in calendar days. A month that begins after the later of the last day of that period and the withdrawal date is not owed. A charge already posted for such a month is credited in full with the credit reason "withdrawal after notice".

**3. Withdrawal without notice.** An enrollment withdrawn without notice owes every month that began on or before the last day of the notice period counted from the withdrawal date.

**4. Refunds.** A credit balance is refunded by district check within the type's refund period (calendar days) after the withdrawal date or the year end. A refund is issued only on an enrollment in status withdrawn or year completed. A refund disbursed increases the amount the household owes on the enrollment, offsetting the credit balance it pays out.

**5. Ledger entries.** Each payment is recorded with its method and the payment confirmation number exactly as issued. A credit offsets one specific tuition charge or late fee, is never more than that charge, and carries one of the credit reasons "eligibility established", "withdrawal after notice" or "billing correction".

## Worked dates with a 14-day notice period (hypothetical school year)

| Notice received | Last day of notice period | Withdrawal date | Later of the two | November tuition | December tuition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 20 October | 3 November | 31 October | 3 November | owed (November began on 1 November, before 3 November) | not owed; if already posted, credited in full |
| 10 October | 24 October | 31 October | 31 October | not owed | not owed |
| no notice | 14 November, counted from the withdrawal date | 31 October | not applicable | owed (began on or before 14 November) | not owed |

## Refund eligibility

| Enrollment status | Refund of a credit balance |
|---|---|
| withdrawn | may be issued |
| year completed | may be issued |
| provisional or enrolled | not issued |

superseded_clauses: Tuition is paid by the methods in accepted_payment_methods and is applied to the enrollment's oldest open charge first; a payment never moves to a sibling's enrollment.
